findings.issue: somos is an unmarked supplied copula; the clause is a verbless participle plus pronoun
Gentilic common noun is left as the Hebraized form midyaní instead of Spanish
A él treats the direct object (the place) as a personal male recipient, so the thing given is no longer the place
2fs suffix is smoothed to gender-neutral a ti; person and number stay 2sg

notes: ustedes matches the 2mp suffix; suegro matches the pointed participle חֹתֵן.
